# ecosystem-atlas

**File**: `src/components/ecosystem-atlas.js` + `src/styles/ecosystem-atlas.css`
**Webflow attribute**: `data-component="ecosystem-atlas"` (inside the "Section / Atlas Map" component, page `/ecosystem-atlas`)
**Data**: `src/data/atlas.json` (MOCK, generated by `scripts/atlas-mock.js`) and `src/data/atlas-world.json` (world-atlas 110m TopoJSON, Natural Earth, public domain)
**Libraries**: `d3-geo` (projections, paths), `topojson-client` (TopoJSON → GeoJSON)

## What it does

- Draws the map in `[data-atlas-stage]` as SVG with d3-geo (one projection that can be NaturalEarth1 flat or Orthographic globe). Land = one merged silhouette + per-country fills (no stroke) + a borders mesh; the graticule is hidden (Figma shows a clean globe). Default globe view `GLOBE_HOME = [55, -38]`; on desktop the globe radius is `min(0.8·stage height, 0.34·stage width)` with its top just under the header, so the panel covers its lower half. Drag rotates the globe.
- Globe sizing (`globeFit`): the whole globe always fits the stage. It sits on the stage bottom (16px gap) and grows, by binary search, as large as it can without touching `.atlas_intro` / `.atlas_controls` when they overlap the stage (measured in `resize()`), capped at half the stage width. The filters panel floats over the lower part of the globe via its negative top margin in Webflow (`atlas_panel` -18rem desktop / -12rem tablet, `atlas_stage` 56rem / 42rem).
- Collapsed panel keeps a bottom margin (`keepSpace`: overlap minus button height) so the page below stays under the map; recomputed on resize (`syncPanelSpace`).
- Load animation (`playIntro`, once, when the stage is 20% in view via IntersectionObserver): map layer fades and scales 0.9→1 (1.2s ease-out), beacons pop in by rank (45ms stagger, slight overshoot), labels fade in last. Skipped with reduced motion.
- Flat ↔ globe is one continuous projection morph (d3 `geoProjectionMutator` blending NaturalEarth1Raw and OrthographicRaw, as in d3's "Orthographic to Equirectangular" example): alpha, rotation, scale and translate share one eased clock (1.3s, cubic in-out) and the globe lands straight on its centered view, no extra spin. `foldAngle(alpha)` clips the far side just before the blended projection folds over itself (where horizontal scale drops to `0.5·√(1-alpha)` of the centre value), reaching exactly 90° at alpha 1; null below alpha ≈ 0.26 (no fold). `morphClip` composes that clip circle with the antimeridian cut, because a clip circle wider than a hemisphere alone lets antimeridian-crossing shapes wrap across the map as straight lines. Beacon visibility follows the same angle, and the sphere fill/outline fade in from alpha 0.25 to 0.85.
- Beacons per ecosystem, colored in 5 steps with the `Map/Beacon *` variables (darker = better, inverted for "Lower is better"). Count measures (`kind: count`) draw as proportional bubbles. Coverage "Countries" (or a country-only measure) paints countries instead.
- Labels avoid each other and the beacons; values use text colors for contrast.
- The round filter button (`[data-atlas-filters-toggle]`) collapses the whole panel (filters + results) into just the button, like closing a popup: a clip-path shrinks the panel into the button, then the freed space closes; expanding reverses it. State: `.atlas_panel.is-collapsed`, `aria-expanded` on the button. The second filter row is always visible.
- Filters are native `<select>`s filled from the JSON (block, measure, coverage, industry, flow, level) and enhanced into custom dropdowns by `src/utils/dropdown.js` (`enhanceSelect`). The `<select>` stays as the source of truth (hidden, `aria-hidden`); the trigger reuses its Webflow class (`atlas_select`, `atlas_profile-select`). Keyboard: Enter/Space/arrows open, arrows/Home/End move, letters type-ahead, Enter picks, Esc closes. Industry/flow/level apply mock multipliers (`factors`). Country-only measures lock coverage.
- The beacon of the entity shown in the profile (selected, or the leader) gets a white ring.
- Ranking `<ol>` and profile card stay in sync with the map (hover highlights, click selects and centers the globe). Ranking and pillar bars animate from their previous width (or 0 on first load) to the new one, staggered 30ms per row (`animateBars`).
- Measure Details band (`[data-atlas-measure]`) takes texts from the Measures CMS card with the same `data-def` key; falls back to the JSON name/unit.
- Drawer (`[data-atlas-drawer]`): tabs Data scope / Methodology / Trend figure / Definitions & formulas, prev/next, Esc and overlay close, focus trap, arrow keys on tabs. Motion (WAAPI): overlay fades, panel slides in from the right (from the bottom on mobile) with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, rail buttons pop in staggered, tabs and content rise a beat later; closing reverses faster with an ease-in, then hides. Tab changes slide the content in from the side of the new tab. Trend figure draws an SVG line chart + table. Definitions cards get block anchors, "Show on map" and "Read more".
- Deep link: `?m=&e=&v=&b=&c=&i=&f=&l=&tab=`.

## JS-only classes (add to Prevent delete in Webflow)

`is-ready`, `is-open`, `is-active`, `is-collapsed`, `is-hot`, `is-selected`, `is-bubble`, `is-tracked`, `is-scored`, `is-strong`, `is-muted`, `is-visible`, `is-globe`, `is-dragging`, `is-atlas-drawer-open`

## Replacing the mock

Keep the shape of `atlas.json` (`blocks`, `measures`, `pillars`, `ecosystems`, `options`, `values[measure][ecosystem][year]`, `pillarScores`, `factors`, `trend[measure]`). Measure `key` must match the CMS "Data key" field.
